purpose.statement: Pay off H1 and the Section 2.4 MA1 design by establishing claim C2: within firms, residual CEO Q&A uncertainty (UncResCEO) is elevated in the pre-announcement quarter of cash acquirers relative to their own other quarters, and is not detectable for stock acquirers; the firm's cash ratio rises in the same quarter while no comparable rise appears for stock. purpose.reason: 2.2 P2 stated H1 as a falsifiable prediction and 2.4 P1 mapped the single-indicator DiD to it; the thesis needs the first empirical pillar (the run-up exists) before timing (3.3) and cash-specificity (3.4) can build on it. C2 is the ledger's rank-2 'solid second pillar'.

subsections.title: Main Analysis 2: Differential Timing Around the Announcement

purpose.statement: Pay off H1b and the Section 2.4 MA2 event-study design by establishing claim C1 (the strongest, two-tailed result): residual Q&A uncertainty spikes in the pre-announcement quarter and collapses the instant the deal is public (the GAP window: announced, not yet closed), while the acquirer's cash ratio does NOT fall at announcement and declines only at completion when cash leaves the firm. The claim rests on the CONTRAST of the two paths (uncertainty on the information clock, cash on the transaction clock), not on the magnitude of any single coefficient.
purpose.reason: C1 is the ledger's rank-1, most-referee-proof result and is mandated to CARRY the paper; 2.2 P4 stated H1b and 2.4 P2 built the event study with the GAP bin as the MNPI discriminator. The round-trip is the thesis's signature finding.

subsections.title: Main Analysis 3: Cash-Specificity

purpose.statement: Pay off H1a and the Section 2.4 MA3 pooled-interacted design by establishing claim C6: the cash-stock difference in the pre-announcement uncertainty run-up survives a FORMAL Wald test of the cash-minus-stock difference (valid at 5%, two-tailed). Critically, SPLIT the EFFECT from the CAUSE: the run-up (EFFECT) is cash-specific and claimable, but the underlying cash build-up (proposed CAUSE) is NOT cash-specific, so the war-chest mechanism stays OPEN. Frame as concentration, not strict specificity; supportive, not definitive.
purpose.reason: 2.2 P3 stated H1a and 2.4 P3 built the pooled interaction with the formal Wald difference as the anti-Gelman-Stern test; C6 is the ledger's rank-6 result that the advisor-corrected ledger confirms is VALID at 5% but fragile (imprecise stock arm) and whose cause leg fails.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger C6 (EFFECT_diff 0.0983** p=.039 VALID at 5%; CAUSE_diff 0.0064 n.s. matched / 0.0092* full; 'survives a formal test' is ACCURATE; do NOT use Gelman-Stern side-by-side)
2.2 P3 (H1a: theta_-1^cash > theta_-1^stock; concentration not specificity)

proposition_chain.statement: Cash-specificity is tested in two steps: first the MA2 event study is rerun side by side on the stock placebo arm (descriptive), then both arms are pooled in a single interacted model that formally tests the cash-minus-stock difference, for the EFFECT (pre-announcement uncertainty) and its proposed CAUSE (the cash build-up) alike. Both tables are two-tailed throughout; the pooled baseline is firms that make neither a cash nor a stock deal.
proposition_chain.reason: Sets up the MA3 design (2.4 P3) and pre-commits to the EFFECT/CAUSE split that is the heart of the honest C6 claim, plus the never-EITHER baseline (SEAM-D) that distinguishes MA3's control pool.
evidence: 2.4 P3.1/P3.2 (pooled interacted spec + Wald, transcribed from empire_cashspec_interaction.py:90)

proposition_chain.statement: Side by side, only the cash arm moves: the cash arm reproduces the run-up and resolution while the stock arm shows none of it (its pre-announcement coefficient is negative and insignificant, and if anything its uncertainty moves the other way across announcement). Neither arm trends into the event (the PRE2 pre-trend is flat in both).
proposition_chain.reason: The descriptive cash-vs-stock contrast from tab:empire_drop_placebo (the contrast reserved out of 3.3) motivates the formal test; the opposite-direction stock move is what later makes the formal gap exceed either coefficient.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger C6 (placebo_cash_PRE1 0.0486***; placebo_stock_PRE1 -0.0404 n.s.; stock PRE1-GAP -0.0756*)

proposition_chain.statement: On the EFFECT, the pooled model delivers the formal cash-specificity result: the cash arm's pre-announcement uncertainty coefficient is significant and the stock arm's is insignificant and negative, and the formal cash-minus-stock Wald difference is significant at the 5% level (two-tailed) -- because the arms move in opposite directions the gap exceeds either coefficient, roughly a third of a residual standard deviation. This formal linear-restriction test, not a comparison of one significant against one insignificant coefficient, is the cash-specificity claim.
proposition_chain.reason: This IS C6: the EFFECT survives the formal Wald test at 5%. Stating it as the linear restriction explicitly avoids the Gelman-Stern fallacy the ledger flags as referee bait.

subsections.title: Ruling Out Analyst Scrutiny

purpose.statement: Pay off the 2.2-P5 flag and the 2.5-P4 promise ('tested in Section 4.1') by establishing claim C4: analyst cash-scrutiny does not account for THIS pre-announcement run-up. Deliver the honest three-step rule-out -- (1) the scrutiny measure is real (CashRatio predicts it), (2) scrutiny alone does not move the residual, (3) in the operative reason-gating model scrutiny is null and its interaction with the pre-announcement window is null while the run-up survives -- AFTER first conceding that the confound is genuine (scrutiny itself rises pre-announcement). Keep the register NULL-only and underpowered: 'does not account for THIS run-up, not that scrutiny never matters.'
purpose.reason: 2.2 P5 flagged the analyst-scrutiny rival as a real competing hypothesis and 2.5 P4 motivated it as an identification threat with its verdict promised in 4.1; the thesis's identification credibility depends on confronting and bounding the most immediate alternative driver of the run-up. C4 is the ledger's rank-4, NULL-only result.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger C4 (NULL ONLY, underpowered; 'does not account for THIS run-up; not that scrutiny never matters'; do NOT strengthen)
2.5 P4 (own the construct + motivation; verdict in 4.1; the confound is real -- scrutiny rises pre-announce)

proposition_chain.statement: The scrutiny alternative holds that pre-deal quarters draw harder analyst questions about cash, and that hard questions, not the deal, produce the hedged answers.
